title: Detailed banana
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bananaBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe94d'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#ffd814'/>
      <stop offset='80%' stop-color='#f2b705'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d99400'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bananaTop' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff176'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffd814'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bananaShadow' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e0a800'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b87a00'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- banana main crescent body -->
  <path d='M22 30
           C30 52, 44 76, 72 84
           C80 86, 86 80, 84 72
           C82 64, 76 62, 70 64
           C58 68, 46 56, 38 40
           C34 32, 28 26, 22 30 Z'
        fill='url(#bananaBody)'/>

  <!-- upper highlight ridge -->
  <path d='M24 32
           C30 50, 44 70, 68 80
           C74 82, 78 78, 76 74
           C74 70, 70 68, 66 69
           C56 72, 46 60, 38 44
           C34 36, 29 30, 24 32 Z'
        fill='url(#bananaTop)' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- lower shadow ridge -->
  <path d='M30 38
           C38 58, 50 76, 72 84
           C76 85, 80 84, 80 80
           C62 76, 50 62, 42 46
           C38 38, 34 34, 30 38 Z'
        fill='url(#bananaShadow)' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- banana tip (bottom right) -->
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='80' rx='6' ry='4' transform='rotate(20 80 80)' fill='#8b6914'/>
  <ellipse cx='80' cy='80' rx='3' ry='2' transform='rotate(20 80 80)' fill='#6b4f0f'/>

  <!-- banana stem (top left) -->
  <path d='M20 30
           C18 26, 18 22, 22 20
           C26 18, 30 20, 30 24
           C30 26, 28 28, 26 30
           C24 32, 22 32, 20 30 Z'
        fill='#7a9a3a'/>
  <path d='M22 22
           C24 21, 26 22, 27 24
           C26 25, 24 25, 22 24 Z'
        fill='#a8c96a' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- stem nub -->
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='25' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#5a7a2a'/>

  <!-- speckles/details on banana body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='1.5' ry='1' fill='#c98a00' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='68' rx='1.2' ry='0.8' fill='#c98a00' opacity='0.45'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='75' rx='1' ry='0.7' fill='#c98a00' opacity='0.4'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='50' rx='1.2' ry='0.8' fill='#c98a00' opacity='0.45'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='42' rx='1' ry='0.7' fill='#c98a00' opacity='0.4'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='64' rx='1' ry='0.6' fill='#c98a00' opacity='0.35'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='78' rx='0.8' ry='0.6' fill='#c98a00' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- bright curved highlight streak -->
  <path d='M30 38
           C36 54, 46 68, 64 76
           C60 74, 52 64, 44 50
           C40 42, 36 36, 30 38 Z'
        fill='#fff9c4' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- subtle top edge shine -->
  <path d='M26 32
           C32 50, 44 68, 68 78'
        stroke='#fffde7' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' opacity='0.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
